decisions.reason: A burner component for radiant heaters builds directly on the firm's core gas radiant heating know-how and supports its installed base, so the firm can interpret its results well and has little reason to drop it, even though it gets less website visibility.
As a flagship electric infrared panel line in its strategic direction, it extends the firm's deep radiant heating knowledge into electrification, and in-house R&D lets the firm keep refining it.
The halogen infrared heater relies on related infrared knowledge and serves outdoor and spot heating niches; it is a more commodity-like single product but fits the broad portfolio of a growing firm.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater line matches the firm's core hall heating customers and engineering expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve the models.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a flagship built on the firm's core gas radiant technology, already in real-world operation, and central to its low-carbon strategy, which gives strong reasons to keep developing it.
